realGaps.Y8: R12 orphaned at the call site: four test_r12_gold_* tests exercise gold() in isolation; nothing asserts the broadsheet treasury line uses it. Swapping the call site to money() changes the page from '110' to '+110' and no test looks. REPEAT — the Wave 6c fix list demanded this.
realGaps.Y12: R9 blind to overflow: test_r9_* build the fixture with turns=1, a page too short to overflow the content rect at either size, so the clip is never exercised. Measured: with surface.set_clip(content) removed and turns=20, 800x600 leaks 1297 pixels outside content — the clip is load-bearing, not redundant.
